blocks.title: yield %1
blocks.description: Yields a value from a generator function.

blocks.title: yield from %1
blocks.description: Delegates to a sub-generator, yielding all of its values.

blocks.title: define generator function %1 ( %2 )
blocks.description: Defines a generator function. Use the 'yield' block inside.

blocks.title: next item from iterator %1 or default %2
blocks.description: Gets the next item from an iterator, returning a default value if it is exhausted.

blocks.title: generator expression: %1 for %2 in %3 if %4
blocks.description: Creates a generator expression, which can be iterated over.

blocks.title: is %1 callable?
blocks.description: Checks if an object is callable (e.g., a function).

blocks.title: define function %1 ( %2 )
blocks.description: Defines a function with parameters.

blocks.title: for index %1, value %2 in %3
blocks.description: Loops through a list with an index and value.

blocks.title: for %1 in zip %2
blocks.description: Loops through multiple lists at once.

blocks.title: lambda %1 : %2
blocks.description: Creates a lambda function.

blocks.title: partially apply function %1 with pre-filled args %2
blocks.description: Creates a new function with some arguments pre-filled.
Applies a decorator to a function definition.

blocks.title: docstring %1
blocks.description: Adds a docstring to a function. Must be the first statement in a function.

blocks.title: try %1
blocks.description: Tries to execute code, and catches an exception.

blocks.title: try %1
blocks.description: Tries to execute code, catches an exception, and runs a final block of code.

blocks.title: raise exception %1 with message %2
blocks.description: Raises an exception.

blocks.title: assert %1 with message %2
blocks.description: Asserts that a condition is true.

blocks.title: match %1
blocks.description: A match-case block (requires Python 3.10+).

blocks.title: list comprehension [ %1 for %2 in %3 if %4 ]
blocks.description: Creates a list using a list comprehension.

blocks.title: dictionary comprehension { %1 : %2 for %3 in %4 if %5 }
blocks.description: Creates a dictionary using a dictionary comprehension.

blocks.title: set comprehension { %1 for %2 in %3 if %4 }
blocks.description: Creates a set using a set comprehension.

blocks.title: generator expression ( %1 for %2 in %3 if %4 )
blocks.description: Creates a generator expression.

blocks.title: calculate %1 of list %2
blocks.description: Calculates a statistical value of a list of numbers.

blocks.title: decimal from %1
blocks.description: Creates a decimal number for high-precision calculations.

blocks.title: fraction with numerator %1 and denominator %2
blocks.description: Creates a fraction.

blocks.title: complex number with real part %1 and imaginary part %2
blocks.description: Creates a complex number.

blocks.title: accumulate %1 with function %2
blocks.description: Returns a list of accumulated results.
